offering_description.value: Eastman supplies advanced materials, functional additives, specialty chemicals and fibers to industrial customers. It develops materials with customers for applications such as coatings, packaging, textiles and medical devices.

quotes.quote: We offer an extensive range of products. Our advanced materials, additives and functional products, specialty chemicals, and fibers are found in items people use every day around the world.

Driven by more than 100 years of innovation, we collaborate with customers around the world across a wide range of industries. For decades, our innovations have improved the quality of life for consumers. Our materials go into everything from can coatings for the food you eat to the fibers in your clothing and home textiles. Our resins make housewares dishwasher safe, tough, and stylish and high-performance medical devices more durable. We provide organic acids that replace antibiotics in animal feed. And our polymers are in low-emissions coatings for homes and cars.

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Food-contact compliance requirements for additives used in coatings and packaging

quotes.quote: Eastman Solus™ 5350 performance additive is designed to provide high-performance in building and construction coatings. This cellulose ester enables coatings to exhibit UV stability & non-yellowing, excellent inter-coat adhesion, clear films, and superior avoidance of surface defects via flow & leveling properties. Production benefits include reduced surface tack, improved thermal reflow, broad compatibility with curing resins & other coating components, low solution viscosity and solubility in a wide range of solvents & solvent combinations. When dissolved in appropriate solvents, a clear colorless solution is produced. Solus™ 5350 is supplied in pellet form, offering formulation convenience, ease of handling and maximum formulating flexibility. </br></br></br> Eastman Solus™ 5350 is based on cellulose, one of the most abundant natural renewable resources.</br></br></br> For applications that require food contact compliance, please discuss requirements with your Eastman technical expert.

Modern packaging formulations are expected to deliver stunning colors, high print throughput, flawless finishes, and durable graphics, all while protecting the safety of end-users. Eastman Solus™ 1225 performance additive is designed to deliver on the high performance expectations required of ink and metal packaging formulations. This cellulose-based additive enables formulations with good resistance to UV discoloration, excellent hardness and anti-blocking properties in support of high production speeds. Solus™ 1225 is well adapted for use in printing inks and overprint varnishes as a result of its wide solubility in relevant solvents, strong compatibility with other ink resins, desirable resistance to grease and oil, low odor properties, and high melting point. When Solus™ 1225 is dissolved in appropriate solvents a clear, colorless solution is produced. Supplied as a dry free-flowing powder, this product is often used in combination with other Solus™ products to optimize the formulation viscosity. </br></br> </br></br> Eastman Solus™ 1225 is based on cellulose, one of Earth's most abundant natural renewable resources, with an approximate calculated bio-content value of 45%. </br></br> </br></br> For applications that require food contact compliance, please refer to Eastman Solus™ 1225, food contact and discuss requirements with your Eastman technical representative.
